name: Vallendester
source:
Vallendester never wanted to be a celestial ruler, so he gave up his position and spends his time traveling across the galaxy as a bounty hunter instead.

Will this meteor ever settle down?

[From [url=https://chouette.itch.io/celestia]itch.io[/url]]
